question: Which of the following could be an appropriate title for the given passage?

options.text: The Importance of Biodiversity and its Conservation
The Impact of Climate Change on the Environment
The Benefits of Ecotourism for Local Communities
The Role of Endangered Species in the Ecosystem

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most suitable title of the passage is "**The Role of Endangered Species in the Ecosystem**".
 
• The passage primarily discusses the importance of biodiversity and the conservation of endangered species.
 
• It highlights why conserving endangered species is essential, including their ecological, cultural, economic, and scientific value.
 
• Hence, the most suitable title of the passage is "**The Role of Endangered Species in the Ecosystem**".

Therefore, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
